arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ عِنْدَ الشِّدَّةِ و الجَحدِ و تَعَسُّرِ اللُمور
english_title: 22. His Supplication in Hardship, Effort, and Difficult Affairs

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ كَلَّفْتَنِي مِنْ نَفْسِي مَا أَنْتَ أَمْلَكُ بِهِ مِنِّي،
phrases.english: 1.O God, You hast charged me concerning myself with that which belongs more to You than to me.

phrases.arabic: وَقُدْرَتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيَّ أَغْلَبُ مِنْ قُدْرَتِي،
phrases.english: 2.Your power over it and over me is greater than my power,

phrases.arabic: فَأَعْطِنِي مِنْ نَفْسِي مَا يُرْضِيْكَ عَنِّي،
phrases.english: 3.so give me in myself what will make You pleased with me

phrases.arabic: وَخُذْ لِنَفْسِكَ رِضَاهَا مِنْ نَفْسِي فِي عَافِيَة.
phrases.english: 4.and take for Yourself Your good pleasure in my self's well-being!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ طَاقَةَ لِي بِالجَهْدِ ، وَلاَ صَبْرَ لِي عَلَى البَلاَءِ،
phrases.english: 5.O God, I have no endurance for effort, no patience in affliction,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ قُوَّةَ لِي عَلَى الْفَقْرِ، فَلاَ تَحْظُرْ عَلَيَّ رِزْقِي،
phrases.english: 6.no strength to bear poverty. So forbid me not my provision

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَكِلْنِيْ إلَى خَلْقِكَ بَلْ تَفَرَّدْ بِحَاجَتِي، وَتَولَّ كِفَايَتِي،
phrases.english: 7.and entrust me not to Your creatures, but take care of my need alone and Yourself attend to sufficing me!

phrases.arabic: وَانْظُرْ إلَيَّ وَانْظُرْ لِي فِي جَمِيْعِ اُمُورِي،
phrases.english: 8.Look upon me and look after me in all my affairs,

phrases.arabic: فَإنَّكَ إنْ وَكَلْتَنِي إلَى نَفْسِي عَجَزْتُ عَنْهَا،
phrases.english: 9.for if You entrust me to myself, I will be incapable before myself

phrases.arabic: وَلَمْ اُقِمْ مَا فِيهِ مَصْلَحَتُهَا،
phrases.english: 10.and fail to undertake that in which my best interest lies.

phrases.arabic: وَإنْ وَكَلْتَنِي إلَى خَلْقِكَ تَجَهَّمُونِي،
phrases.english: 11.If You entrust me to Your creatures, they will frown upon me,

phrases.arabic: وَإنْ أَلْجَأتَنِيْ إلَى قَرَابَتِي حَرَمُونِي،
phrases.english: 12.and if You makest me resort to my kinsfolk, they will refuse to give to me;

phrases.arabic: وَإنْ أَعْطَوْا أَعْطَوْا قَلِيْلاً نَكِداً،
phrases.english: 13.if they give, they will give little and in bad temper,

phrases.arabic: وَمَنُّوا عَلَيَّ طَوِيلاً وَذَمُّوا كَثِيراً.
phrases.english: 14.making me feel long obliged and blaming me much.

phrases.arabic: فَبِفَضْلِكَ أللَّهُمَّ فَأَغْنِنِي، وَبِعَظَمَتِكَ فَانْعَشنِي،
phrases.english: 15.So through Your bounty, O God, free me from need, through Your mightiness, lift me up,

phrases.arabic: وَبِسَعَتِكَ فَابْسُطْ يَدِي، وَبِمَا عِنْدَكَ فَاكْفِنِي.
phrases.english: 16.through Your boundless plenty, open my hand, and with that which is with You, suffice me!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ،
phrases.english: 17.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَخَلِّصْنِي مِنَ الْحَسَدِ، وَاحْصُرْنِي عَن الذُّنُوبِ،
phrases.english: 18.rid me of envy, encircle me against sins,

phrases.arabic: وَوَرِّعْنِي عَنِ الْمَحَارِمِ، وَلا تُجَرِّئْنِي عَلَى الْمَعَاصِي،
phrases.english: 19.make me abstain from things unlawful, give me not the boldness of disobedient acts,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ هَوايَ عِنْدَكَ، وَرِضَايَ فِيمَا يَرِدُ عَلَيَّ مِنْكَ،
phrases.english: 20.assign me love for that which is with You and satisfaction with that which comes to me from You,

phrases.arabic: وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيْمَا رَزَقْتَنِي، وَفِيمَا خَوَّلْتَنِي،
phrases.english: 21.bless me in that which You providest me, that which You conferrest upon me,

phrases.arabic: وَفِيمَا أَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَيَّ، وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي كُلِّ حَالاَتِي
phrases.english: 22.and that through which You favourest me, and make me in all my states

phrases.arabic: مَحْفُوظَاً مَكْلُوءاً مَسْتُوراً مَمْنُوعاً مُعَاذاً مُجَاراً.
phrases.english: 23.safeguarded, watched, covered, defended, given refuge, and granted sanctuary!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 24.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَاقْضِ عَنِّي كُلّ مَا أَلْزَمْتَنِيهِ وَفَرَضْتَهُ عَلَيَّ لَكَ فِي وَجْه مِنْ  وُجُوهِ طَاعَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 25.and let me accomplish everything which You hast enjoined upon me or made obligatory for me toward You, in one of the ways of Your obedience,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ لِخَلْق مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَإنْ ضَعُفَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ بَدَنِي، وَوَهَنَتْ عَنْهُ قُـوَّتِي،
phrases.english: 26.or toward one of Your creatures, though my body be too frail for that, my strength too feeble,

phrases.arabic: وَلَمْ تَنَلْهُ مَقْدِرَتِي، وَلَمْ يَسَعْهُ مَالِي وَلاَ ذَاتُ يَدِي، ذَكَرْتُهُ أَوْ نَسِيتُهُ
phrases.english: 27.my power not able to reach it, and my possessions and what my hand owns not encompass it, and whether I have remembered it or forgotten it.

phrases.arabic: هُوَ يَا رَبِّ مِمَّا قَدْ أَحْصَيْتَهُ عَلَيَّ وَأَغْفَلْتُهُ أَنَا مِنْ نَفْسِي،
phrases.english: 28.It, my Lord, is among that which You hast counted against me while I have been heedless of it in myself.

phrases.arabic: فَأَدِّهِ عَنِّي مِنْ جَزِيْلِ عَطِيَّتِكَ وَكَثِيرِ مَا عِنْدَكَ،
phrases.english: 29.Let me perform it through Your plentiful giving and the abundance which is with You

phrases.arabic: فَإنَّكَ وَاسِعٌ  كَرِيمٌ حَتَّى لاَ يَبْقَى عَلَيَّ شَيْ مِنْهُ
phrases.english: 30.- for You art Boundless, Generous - so that nothing of it may remain against me,

phrases.arabic: تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُقَاصَّنِي بِهِ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِي،
phrases.english: 31.lest You wouldst wish to settle accounts for it from my good deeds

phrases.arabic: أَوْ تُضَاعِفَ بِهِ مِنْ سَيِّئاتِي يَوْمَ أَلْقَاكَ يَا رَبِّ.
phrases.english: 32.or to compound my evil deeds on the day I meet You, my Lord!

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 33.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَارْزُقْنِي الرَّغْبَةَ فِي الْعَمَـلِ لَكَ لآخِـرَتِي،
phrases.english: 34.and provide me with desire to serve You for the sake of my state in the hereafter,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى أَعْرِفَ صِدْقَ ذلِكَ مِنْ قَلْبِي،
phrases.english: 35.such that I know the truthfulness of that [desire] in my heart,

phrases.arabic: وَحَتَّى يَكُونَ الْغَالِبُ عَلَيَّ الزُّهْدُ فِي دُنْيَايَ،
phrases.english: 36.be dominated by renunciation while in this world,

phrases.arabic: وَحَتَّى أَعْمَلَ الْحَسَنَاتِ شَوْقاً،
phrases.english: 37.do good deeds with yearning,

phrases.arabic: وَآمَنَ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ فَرَقاً وَخَوْفاً،
phrases.english: 38.and remain secure from evil deeds in fright and fear!

phrases.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي نُوراً أَمْشِي بِهِ فِي النَّاسِ، وَأَهْتَدِي بِهِ فِي الظُّلُماتِ،
phrases.english: 39.And give me 'a light whereby I may walk among the people' (ref.6:122), be guided in the shadows,

phrases.arabic: وَأَسْتَضِيءُ بِهِ مِنَ الشَّكِّ وَالشُّبُهَـاتِ .
phrases.english: 40.and seek illumination in doubt and uncertainty!

phrases.arabic: اللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 41.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَارْزُقْنِي خَوْفَ غَمِّ الْوَعِيْـدِ،
phrases.english: 42.and provide me with fear of the threatened gloom

phrases.arabic: وَشَوْقَ ثَوَابِ الْمَوْعُودِ حَتَّى أَجِدَ لَذَّةَ مَا أَدْعُوكَ لَهُ،
phrases.english: 43.and yearning for the promised reward, such that I may find the pleasure of that for which I supplicate You

phrases.arabic: وَكَأْبَةَ مَا أَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ مِنْهُ.
phrases.english: 44.and the sorrow of that from which I seek sanctuary in You!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ قَـدْ تَعْلَمُ مَا يُصْلِحُنِي مِنْ أَمْرِ دُنْيَايَ وَآخِـرَتِي،
phrases.english: 45.O God, You knowest what will set my affairs right in this world and the next,

phrases.arabic: فَكُنْ بِحَوَائِجِيْ حَفِيّاً.
phrases.english: 46.so be ever gracious toward my needs!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد
phrases.english: 47.O God, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household

phrases.arabic: وَارْزُقْنِي الْحَقَّ عِنْدَ تَقْصِيرِي فِي الشُّكْرِ لَكَ
phrases.english: 48.and provide me with what is Your right when I fall short in thanking You

phrases.arabic: بِمَا أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ فِي اليُسـرِ وَالْعُسْرِ وَالصِّحَّـةِ وَالسَّقَمِ
phrases.english: 49.for that through which You hast favoured me in ease and difficulty, health and sickness,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى أَتَعَرَّفَ مِنْ نَفْسِي رَوْحَ الرِّضَا
phrases.english: 50.such that I may come to know in myself repose in satisfaction

phrases.arabic: وَطُمَأنِينَةَ النَّفْسِ مِنِّي بِمَا يَجِبُ لَكَ فِيمَا يَحْدُثُ
phrases.english: 51.and serenity of soul in that which You hast made incumbent upon me

phrases.arabic: فِي حَالِ الْخَوْفِ وَالاَمْنِ،
phrases.english: 52.in whatever states may occur: fear and security,

phrases.arabic: وَالرِّضَا وَالسُّخْطِ، وَالضَّرِّ وَالنَّفْعِ.
phrases.english: 53.satisfaction and displeasure, loss and gain!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 54.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَارْزُقْنِي سَلاَمَةَ الصَّدْرِ مِنَ الْحَسَدِ
phrases.english: 55.and provide me with a breast safe from envy,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ أَحْسُدَ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ عَلَى شَيْء مِنْ فَضْلِكَ،
phrases.english: 56.such that I envy none of Your creatures and in anything of Your bounty

phrases.arabic: وَحَتَّى لاَ أَرى نِعْمَـةً مِنْ نِعَمِـكَ عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
phrases.english: 57.and such that I see none of Your favours toward any of Your creatures

phrases.arabic: فِي دِيْن أَوْ دُنْيا، أَوْ عَافِيَة أَوْ تَقْوَى،
phrases.english: 58.in religion or this world, well-being or reverential fear,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ سَعَة أَوْ رَخاء، إلاّ رَجَوْتُ لِنَفْسِي أَفْضَلَ ذلِكَ،
phrases.english: 59.plenty or ease, without hoping for myself better than it

phrases.arabic: بِكَ وَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ.
phrases.english: 60.through and from You alone, who hast no associate!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّـد وَآلِـهِ
phrases.english: 61.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَارْزُقْنِي التَّحَفُّظَ مِن الْخَطَايَا،
phrases.english: 62.and provide me with caution against offenses

phrases.arabic: وَالاحْتِرَاسَ مِنَ الزَّلَلِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ،
phrases.english: 63.and wariness against slips in this world and the next

phrases.arabic: فِي حَالِ الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ،
phrases.english: 64.in the state of satisfaction and wrath,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى أكُونَ بِمَا يَرِدُ عَلَيَّ مِنْهُمَا بِمَنْزِلَة سَوَاء،
phrases.english: 65.such that I may remain indifferent toward that which enters upon me from the two states,

phrases.arabic: عَامِلاً بِطَاعَتِكَ مُؤْثِراً لِرِضَاكَ عَلَى مَا سِوَاهُمَا فِي الأَوْلِياءِ وَالأعْدَاءِ
phrases.english: 66.work toward Your obedience, and prefer it and Your good pleasure over all else in both friends and enemies.

phrases.arabic: حَتّى يَأْمَنَ عَدُوِّي مِنْ ظُلْمِي وَجَوْرِي،
phrases.english: 67.Then my enemy may stay secure from my wrongdoing and injustice

phrases.arabic: وَيَيْأَسَ وَلِيِّي مِنْ مَيْلِي وَانْحِطَاطِ هَوَايَ،
phrases.english: 68.and my friend may despair of my inclination and the bent of my affection.

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلنِي مِمَّنْ يَدْعُوكَ مُخْلِصاً في الرَّخَاءِ
phrases.english: 69.Make me one of those who supplicate You with sincerity in ease

phrases.arabic: دُعَـاءَ الْمُخْلِصِينَ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ لَـكَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ
phrases.english: 70.with the supplication of those who supplicate You with sincerity in distress!

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجيدٌ .
phrases.english: 71.Verily You art Praiseworthy, Glorious.
